rules.title: Legacy TBox Iterate Array attribute
rules.description: Tosca 2026.1 changes TBox Iterate Array to support multiple buffer arrays. Legacy Array To Iterate and Target Buffer attributes must be updated to the Array ModuleAttribute.
rules.recommendedAction: Update the affected TBox Iterate Array module, then validate every linked test case after the upgrade.

rules.title: SeaLights integration configuration present
rules.description: Tosca 2026.1 adds SeaLights configuration parameters. This is not a confirmed break; review the existing integration before rollout.
rules.recommendedAction: Review SeaLights configuration and perform a post-upgrade connectivity validation.
